theorems.name: Submission.idtp_ccd_scsp_cone_conservation
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (u e : Euclid P) (r₀ s : ℝ) (N : Set (Euclid P)) (γ : ℝ → Euclid P) (T : Euclid P → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), ‖u‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ u e = 0 → 0 < s → s < r₀ → IsOpen N → (∀ x ∈ N, 0 < inner ℝ x u) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 γ (Ioo (-s) s) → (∀ α ∈ Ioo (-s) s, ‖γ α‖ = 1 ∧ 0 < inner ℝ (γ α) u ∧ Real.arctan (inner ℝ (γ α) e / inner ℝ (γ α) u) = α) → (∀ t ∈ Ioo (r₀ - s) (r₀ + s), ∀ α ∈ Ioo (-s) s, t • γ α ∈ N ∧ T (t • γ α) = Submodule.span ℝ {γ α, deriv γ α}) → (∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ N → ∫ x in (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => q.1 • γ q.2) '' (Ioo (r₀ - s) (r₀ + s) ×ˢ Ioo (-s) s), LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) ((T x).starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ X x).toLinearMap) ∂μHE[2] = 0) → ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ Ioo (-s) s → ∫ α, deriv φ α * ((inner ℝ (γ α) u ^ 2 + inner ℝ (γ α) e ^ 2) / ‖deriv γ α‖) = 0
